title: Exact-SKU stocked capacity-source domain and D1 persistence
selectedDiscoveryOption: Option B — exact-SKU stocked capacity-source domain + D1 persistence
upstream: Canonical FOOD-007A exact-SKU stocked capacity-source candidate.

domain.sku: Derived only from canonical FOOD-007A replay at the public append boundary.
domain.capacityUnits: Derived exactly from canonical FOOD-007A replay; public callers cannot supply independent SKU or capacityUnits.
domain.revision: Positive JavaScript safe integer. Durable history sequencing is enforced by persistence.
domain.attribution: Explicit caller-supplied nonempty unpadded text up to 512 characters.
domain.sourceReference: Explicit caller-supplied nonempty unpadded text up to 512 characters.

candidateRevalidation: deriveFoodExactSkuStockedCapacitySourceRevisionFromCandidate strictly replays FOOD-007A from the candidate retained FOOD-006Z provenance and requires exact canonical candidate equality before deriving SKU/capacity.
provenance: Full FOOD-007A/006Z provenance is required in memory at the public write boundary. Only SKU/version/revision/capacity/attribution/source-reference are persisted. sourceReference is a reference string, not authenticated truth. Durable persistence and the latest stored revision do not establish current physical truth.

persistence.sequence: A new noninitial revision must be exactly latest stored revision + 1.
persistence.exactRetry: Exact same durable revision is already-present.
persistence.insertRace: Reread exact durable identity; exact content -> already-present, divergent content -> conflict, absent/malformed/read failure -> storage-failure.
persistence.writes: At most one INSERT attempt. No UPDATE. No DELETE.
persistence.publicInput: Canonical candidate write request with exactly candidate, revision, attribution, sourceReference. Public append invokes deriveFoodExactSkuStockedCapacitySourceRevisionFromCandidate before any database access. Invalid candidate/write requests perform zero DB reads and zero inserts.

safeClaim: An immutable historical exact-SKU capacity-source revision can be derived from canonical FOOD-007A plus explicit revision provenance and durably appended to the existing capacity-source history.
next: Discover the next true reservation/capacity-read boundary after stocked-SKU source persistence.
